thread:
amy_sales: Heads up team 10: ZenithHealth just signed LOI for a committed plan. They want a clear capacity map for POC -> production: target p95 <200ms, peak 600 rps, avg 120 tokens/request. Also need a short doc on reserved GPUs + autoscale triggers and pricing delta.
derek_soleng: Congrats. Quick clarifying q: is 600rps a 5-min sustained peak or short spikes? Also which model/context? They told us 'mistral-like 8k' in the call.
paul_sales: From customer: they expect sustained peaks during business hours with spiky bursts around 1-2min. Plan to start on hosted but may require VPC if legal signs off.
nisha_sre: Operational notes: recommend reserved pool sized for 70% of steady expected throughput and allow burst capacity using credits. For 600 rps and 120 tokens, that's 72k toks/s. On our benchmarks, a tuned fp16 A100-80 handles ~160k toks/s for similar seqs; so 1 GPU covers baseline, but we need redundancy and headroom.
derek_soleng: Proposed minimal reserved config: 2 x A100-80 in reserved pool (one active, one standby for failover/autoscale). Burst plan: add spot/burst GPUs to allow up to 2.5x for short spikes. Preheat: 30m baseline, 45m if they pick private deployment.
tasha_eng: Add specific autoscale knobs:
```
scale_policy:
  metric: token_throughput
  scale_up: >80k toks/s sustained 45s
  scale_down: <30k toks/s for 120s
queue_policy:
  max_queue: 200
  backpressure: 80% CPU or 75% mem
fallback_order: [fp16-A100, q4_A100, q4_cpu]
circuit_breaker: p99_latency > 1200ms for 90s -> route to fallback + page oncall
prewarm: replay_top_n: 250
```
paul_sales: For pricing: finance prefers reserve + monthly commit. If we bill a one-week prewarm as an onboarding fee, they'll push back. Suggest including prewarm in the first month's committed usage as credits. I'll draft numbers once hardware choice is confirmed.
amy_sales: Security note: if they require VPC/private, we must confirm allowed KMS provider and log retention window. That affects whether we can use hosted fallback tiers for failover.
nisha_sre: Right. Private means more conservative cold-starts; increase preheat to 45m and run KV warmup job that replays last 1h of traffic pre-launch to warm top keys. Also include a KV coverage target: 85-90% hot-key hit rate before cutover.
derek_soleng: I'll assemble a 1-page POC handoff doc with capacity calc, autoscale policy, fallback tiers, and a short pricing note. Will post a link here in ~2h.
infra-bot: action: reserved-pool/request created -> rp-410222; ETA provisioning 40m.
amy_sales: Fantastic. Please cc @paul_sales on the pricing note and @tasha_eng on the runbook. We'll send this to ZenithHealth tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
